findings.description: The offline give-up path and the Wi-Fi reconnect path now share one timer handle (s_retry_timer moved to file scope). esp_timer fixes a timer's callback at creation, so whichever path creates the handle decides the callback for both uses. If the broker give-up fires first, a later Wi-Fi disconnect reuses the handle and its one-shot Wi-Fi restart kills the periodic broker retry; if a Wi-Fi disconnect created it first, a later broker give-up restarts it periodic with the wifi_retry_cb callback still attached, so every 30 s the panel calls esp_wifi_connect() and never reconnects the broker.
findings.evidence: app_mqtt.cpp:66 single static esp_timer_handle_t s_retry_timer; :231-240 offline give-up creates it with callback &offline_retry_cb and start_periodic; :382-391 Wi-Fi disconnect reuses the same handle with callback &wifi_retry_cb and start_once (search for s_retry_timer lists both sites).
findings.failureScenario: Wi-Fi drops (timer created for wifi_retry_cb, one-shot 30 s) and then the broker gives up (300 s, no session): the pending Wi-Fi retry is cancelled, the timer restarts periodic with wifi_retry_cb still attached, and every 30 s the panel calls esp_wifi_connect() and never reconnects the MQTT client - the broker stays down until a reboot or a manual mqtt-broker. In the other order a single Wi-Fi drop silently stops the broker retry, restoring the never-retried state this change was meant to remove.
findings.suggestedChange: Use two separate esp_timer handles (Wi-Fi retry and broker retry) or one callback that branches on a mode flag; never reuse a timer created with a different callback.

findings.description: The factory reset remains a 10 s hold of the single front button rather than the spec's SET+MODE combination; control.cpp binds only handles[0], which supports the writer's statement that the group's other buttons do not report separately.
findings.evidence: app_logic.cpp:375-376 COMBO_ARM_MS on handles[0]; control.cpp zc_set_btn_init binds only handles[0].
findings.failureScenario: A finger resting on the front button for 10 s wipes Wi-Fi, broker and room topics without a second confirming button.
findings.suggestedChange: Record the deviation in the product description, or require a confirming gesture inside the countdown.

notes: Voice vocabulary is now 21 phrases: set the <room> to 20 / 21 / 21.5 and <room> 21 and a half for each of four rooms, plus Kitchen/Bedroom refusals, warm up, cool down and cancel; the spec example set the office to 21 (21.0 C) is now recognised.
Offline give-up is on by default: after 300 s without a session the client stops, one line is logged, and offline_retry_cb reconnects it every 30 s.
The broker retry and the Wi-Fi retry share the s_retry_timer handle, so whichever path creates it decides the callback for both (see finding).

The commissioned-reboot crash changed frame again (ppTask -> ppProcessTxQ -> ppGetTxframe at PC 0x2FAFAAD4) with the same cache-error signature, strengthening the emulator/memory-corruption hypothesis; still deferred to hardware.
The settings page fix is verified only by construction (no network peer and no browser in the lab).
